g.text: System Architecture Diagram - Edge to Cloud Predictive Maintenance
Presents the full layered architecture from physical machines
to sensors, ESP32 edge nodes, MQTT gateway, cloud processing,
Physical assets: motors, pumps, fans, compressors, conveyors
Local ESP32 node reads wired sensors and tags records
MQTT over Wi-Fi carries telemetry and alert topics
Cleans data, extracts features, predicts health, creates alerts
Stores history and presents dashboard/report outputs
